description: Composite provenance figure: T4L catalytic geometry, GH24 catalytic-position table, and gp15 active-site shell from a 47.9% identity crystal template
code:
import numpy as np, pandas as pd, matplotlib.pyplot as plt

# values computed in the preceding cells (all from public structures / UniProt)
nb = pd.DataFrame([
 (37,'E',0.60,'E15'),(113,'Y',3.85,'Y89'),(56,'G',4.24,'G36'),(36,'F',4.56,'F14'),(33,'I',5.60,'I11'),
 (44,'Y',5.91,'Y22'),(158,'R',6.24,'R134'),(55,'F',6.29,'Y35'),(114,'N',6.36,'N90'),(52,'T',6.45,'T32'),
 (38,'G',7.04,'G16'),(81,'L',7.46,'L57'),(34,'K',7.51,'K12'),(57,'T',7.70,'H37'),(58,'I',8.14,'Y38'),
 (84,'D',8.33,'D60'),(46,'D',8.61,'P26'),(35,'G',8.63,'S13'),(39,'K',9.30,'L17'),(54,'G',9.34,'G34'),
 (88,'F',9.43,'F64'),(110,'S',9.44,'S86'),(155,'L',9.61,'L131'),(53,'I',9.64,'I33'),(40,'R',9.88,'Q18'),
 (159,'R',9.98,'R135')], columns=['resi9KBQ','aa9KBQ','d','gp15'])

fig,axes=plt.subplots(1,3,figsize=(16,7),gridspec_kw={'width_ratios':[1.25,1,1.15]})

# ---- panel A: 148L geometry ----
ax=axes[0]
lab=['Glu26 OE2\n(engineered,\ncovalent)','Asp20 OD1\n(WT, 2LZM frame)','Glu11 OE2\n(general acid)','Thr26 OG1\n(WT)','Gln105 NE2','Arg145 NH1','Glu22 OE2','Lys35 NZ','Asp70 OD2']
val=[1.51,3.61,3.86,5.15,5.57,5.65,7.98,9.92,9.58]
col=['#2c7fb8','#e67e22','#c0392b','#8e6fb0','#95a5a6','#95a5a6','#95a5a6','#95a5a6','#95a5a6']
ax.barh(range(len(val)),val,color=col)
ax.set_yticks(range(len(val)));ax.set_yticklabels(lab,fontsize=8);ax.invert_yaxis()
ax.axvline(4.5,ls='--',c='k',lw=0.8)
ax.set_xlabel("distance to MurNAc C1, angstrom")
ax.set_title("A. T4 lysozyme catalytic centre\nPDB 148L with bound MurNAc-GlcNAc-peptide\n(wild-type side chains from 2LZM, CA RMSD 0.57 A)",fontsize=9)
ax.text(0.98,0.03,"only Glu11 and Asp20 flank the\nscissile carbon within 4.5 A",transform=ax.transAxes,ha='right',fontsize=8)

# ---- panel B: GH24 catalytic positions across the family ----
ax=axes[1]; ax.axis('off')
labels=["T4 lysozyme","Dictyostelium LysT1","T4 gp5 needle","P22 gp19","phage T1","phage Mu",
        "A. baumannii PHAb10 (9KBQ)","", "phi29 gp15","PZA gp15","B103 gp15","L. phage c2 lysin","L. phage vML3 lysin"]
vals=[["E11","D20","T26"],["E13","D22","T28"],["E184","D193","T199"],["E16","D25","T31"],["E27","D36","T42"],
      ["E37","D46","T52"],["E37","D46","T52"],None,
      ["E15","P26","T32"],["E15","P26","T32"],["E15","P26","T32"],["E15","P24","T32"],["E15","P24","T32"]]
ax.set_title("B. Residues at the three GH24 catalytic positions",fontsize=9)
for x,t in zip([0.46,0.66,0.86],["general\nacid","GH24 Asp","alpha-side\nThr"]):
    ax.text(x,0.95,t,fontsize=8,ha='center',va='center',fontweight='bold')
for k,(lab_,v) in enumerate(zip(labels,vals)):
    y=0.88-0.066*k
    ax.text(0.0,y,lab_,fontsize=8,va='center')
    if v is None: continue
    for c,(cv,x) in enumerate(zip(v,[0.46,0.66,0.86])):
        bad=(c==1 and cv[0] not in "DE")
        ax.text(x,y,cv,fontsize=8,va='center',ha='center',
                bbox=dict(boxstyle='round,pad=0.22',fc='#f1948a' if bad else '#aed6f1',ec='none'))
ax.text(0.0,0.02,"red = GH24 aspartate absent (UniProt CAUTION:\n'Lacks the conserved Asp active site')",fontsize=8)

# ---- panel C: 9KBQ active-site shell mapped to gp15 ----
ax=axes[2]
nb2=nb.sort_values('d')
y=np.arange(len(nb2))
cols=['#27ae60' if a in 'DE' else '#bdc3c7' for a in nb2.aa9KBQ]
ax.barh(y,nb2.d,color=cols)
ax.set_yticks(y)
ax.set_yticklabels([f"{a}{r}  ->  {g}" for a,r,g in zip(nb2.aa9KBQ,nb2.resi9KBQ,nb2.gp15)],fontsize=7.5)
ax.invert_yaxis()
for i,(a,g,d_) in enumerate(zip(nb2.aa9KBQ,nb2.gp15,nb2.d)):
    if a in 'DE':
        ok = g[0] in 'DE'
        ax.text(d_+0.15,i,"kept" if ok else "LOST (Pro)",fontsize=7.5,va='center',
                color='#27ae60' if ok else '#c0392b',fontweight='bold')
ax.set_xlabel("distance of side chain to catalytic Glu carboxylate, angstrom")
ax.set_title("C. Active-site shell of PHAb10 (9KBQ, 1.52 A,\n47.9% identical to gp15) mapped onto phi29 gp15\ngreen bars = acidic in the template",fontsize=9)
ax.set_xlim(0,12)
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
